image_description: A medium shot of two people (a woman on the left, a man on the right) standing in a boat on a lake, holding a very large sturgeon horizontally between them. The background shows water, a distant tree-lined shore, and a cloudy sky.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elongated head with protrusible mouth on ventral surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The fish's head is clearly visible; the snout is elongated and the mouth is located on the underside (ventral), consistent with sturgeon anatomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Four barbels (sensory whiskers) anterior to mouth.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Four distinct, dangling barbels are visible hanging from the snout area in front of the mouth.
The snout tapers to a distinct point at the anterior end of the fish.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elongated fusiform body with impressively large, extended proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The body is long, torpedo-shaped (fusiform), and spans the width of the two holders, indicating large proportions.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Five rows of bony scutes (plates) along body instead of scales.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Distinct rows of raised, bony plates (scutes) are visible running longitudinally along the lateral line and dorsal ridge. No typical fish scales are present.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Gray, brown, or black dorsally with lighter ventral surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The top of the fish is dark gray/brown, transitioning to a pale white/cream color on the belly.
The caudal fin is clearly visible on the right; the upper lobe is significantly larger and longer than the lower lobe, characteristic of a heterocercal tail.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific species identification and rule out look-alike primitive fish.
To verify the integrity of the scutes and ensure no fusion artifacts between the fish and the holders' hands.
To check for subtle AI artifacts in the complex interaction between humans and the large object (hands/fish interface).

focus_areas: Interface between human hands and fish body (checking for melting/fusion)
Anatomical correctness of the heterocercal tail
Lighting consistency on the fish vs. the background
